messages:
anna_sales: heads up — Enterprise Customer 'Orchid Health' asked for a bundle: SSO/SCIM SCIM provisioning, a Terraform provider for Redwood Dedicated, a marketplace listing (AWS Marketplace), and Python SDK auth samples. They want an ETA for Q2.

alex: thanks anna. do we have an intake form from them? is this a single purchase + onboarding or exploratory POC?

anna_sales: single purchase but will pilot across 3 product teams. main asks: automated SCIM sync (create/update/deactivate), Terraform module for infra provisioning + model pinning, and a marketplace listing for procurement. security review also flagged by their legal.

maya_pm: marking this for triage. can we break into MVP vs stretch? my suggestion: MVP = SCIM basic provisioning (users + groups), Terraform: module to create a dedicated workspace and attach model version, Python SDK: sample showing service account auth and token rotation. Marketplace listing + full procurement pack = stretch.

sam_eng: agree. rough estimates: SCIM basic = 2 sprint eng + 1 sprint QA (need audit logs), TF provider = 1–2 sprint prototype if we can reuse existing infra libs, python sample = <1 sprint. security review depends on SOC2/KMS integration.

jen_infra: fyi we already have an internal terraform module for Dedicated tiling; can extract a published provider/registry module. migration work: add model pin config and RBAC bindings.

alex: what are launch acceptance criteria? we should be explicit so sales has clear expectations. Maya, can you list required PRs/tests/docs?

maya_pm: acceptance criteria (MVP):
- SCIM: automated provisioning for create/update/deactivate for users and groups, SCIM logs in Console, audit log entries for each action.
- TF module: example usage + CI test that applies/destroys against a sandbox dedicated account.
- SDK sample: code snippet that shows service account auth + token rotation with a README.
- Security: checklist passed (KMS integration or documented workaround), threat model reviewed.
- Docs: public docs + quickstart + changelog entry.

sam_eng: add performance SLO: SCIM sync batch up to 10k users/day without manual throttling.

anna_sales: client also asked for SCIM deprovision safety net (soft-delete window) and SCIM delta sync support if possible.

maya_pm: scope note — soft-delete window = stretch for MVP; we can offer manual rollback instructions. if they need auto rollback, that's part of v1.

triage-bot: suggested labels -> ["integration:scim", "integration:terraform", "sdk:python", "marketplace:aws", "priority:P2", "needs-security-review"]

alex: those labels look good. set initial priority P2 (sales says timeline Q2 but not committed to enterprise contract yet).

jen_infra: question on TF provider: do we publish to terraform registry or provide registry-compatible module + example? publishing requires CLA & package docs.

maya_pm: for MVP publish registry-compatible module in our GH org (no Terraform Registry publish until legal sign-off). docs must include example `pin_model = "v1.2.3"` and `rbac = { team = "ops" }`.

sam_eng: dev notes: we need an E2E test harness that spins up: dedicated infra -> deploy small model -> run SCIM create user -> verify user token issued and appears in console. I'll add test tasks to the ticket.

anna_sales: customer asked about dates. can we give a loose ETA?

maya_pm: rough ETA if we start planning next week: MVP in ~6 weeks (2 sprints) assuming no high-priority security blockers. I'll block dependency meetings with security and legal.

alex: fine. next actions:
- maya create backlog ticket with attached labels + acceptance criteria (MVP vs stretch)
- sam scope tech tasks + estimate
- jen prepare infra extraction plan for TF module
- anna confirm customer flexibility on soft-delete and marketplace timing

anna_sales: will confirm and push for clarity tomorrow. thanks all. :thumbsup:

triage-bot: created ticket RW-7831 in product backlog with labels: integration:scim, integration:terraform, sdk:python, priority:P2, needs-security-review

maya_pm: added checklist to RW-7831 and assigned initial owners. closing thread here — ping if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
